title: 第13章  那小子肯定逃了！
content_zh:
“怪不得女剑仙会给我这口鼎，这简直太逆天了。”
“嘿嘿，这么逆天的东西，她都舍得给我，毫无疑问，她已经被我征服，肯定是爱上我了，没错，只有这一个解释。”
“继续猎杀野兽。”
楚弛一路深入，很快，眼前出现了一头一级五阶野兽。
只要不被五级野兽击中，楚弛施展《七剑斩》，也能轻松将之斩杀。
这一次，斩杀了二十头野兽，他才得到一颗五阶兽丹。
没有迟疑，他将五阶兽丹吃下了肚子。
在镇天鼎神秘力量的作用下，兽丹的能量，完全被他的身体转化、吸收。
他丹田和隐脉里的灵气，以肉眼可见的速度，变得明亮！
“果然，兽丹的等级要是高于我的修为，对我的帮助最大。按照这个速度，再来三五颗一级五阶兽丹，我就可以冲击凡人境五层了！”
“不过，兽丹形成的概率很低，怕是要猎杀至少一百头一级五阶野兽，这太浪费时间。不如，直接杀一级六阶野兽吧，说不定，一枚兽丹就够了！”
不得不说，楚弛的想法很疯狂。
他居然打算越两层修为击杀野兽。
要知道，野兽身躯，一直都比人类强。
同级，野兽无敌。除非，修者学会了强于自身的武技。
一路深入，楚弛一边寻找灵药，一边寻找野兽。
三个时辰过去，他终于发现了第一头一级六阶野兽。
这是一只红眼睛的兔子，但它的体型，比普通的兔子大十倍。
那锋利的牙齿，更是能轻松咬穿大树。
“居然是铁牙兔！”

楚弛二话不说，掉头就走。
铁牙兔，他的确可以杀，但前提是铁牙兔，不躲避，不逃跑！
但，兔子的速度，绝对不慢。
他如果无法一击必杀，反而会激怒铁牙兔，被铁牙兔追杀。
除非，他动用镇天鼎！
镇天鼎坚硬，即能防身，又能凭借本身数万斤的力量，直接将野兽砸死。
但，镇天鼎这东西，怎么能在光天化日下动用呢？
野兽山岭里，还是有其他修者的。
楚弛正准备退走，眼神忽然一眯。
“不对，好像受伤了！”
这只铁塔兔蹲在地上，它的身下，有血。
楚弛思考了一下，捡起一块石头，远远朝铁牙兔砸了过去。
铁牙兔耳朵灵敏，察觉到风声，立马躲开！
但楚弛看得清楚，铁牙兔的身体，踉踉跄跄。它的一只腿，被人打断了。
另外一只腿，也有伤痕！
它刚刚躲开，就摔倒在了地上。
“哈哈哈，天助我也！”
楚弛不知道这只铁牙兔同谁战斗过，但，这是为他做了嫁衣啊！
楚弛手持长剑，快速冲了过去。
铁牙兔察觉到危机，拔腿就跑！

但，一只腿断了，一只腿伤了。
它的速度，慢到了极点。
楚弛追上去后，长剑刺出。
五道剑光，出现在铁牙兔身旁。
其中一道剑光，落在了铁牙兔的脑袋上。
铁牙兔的脑袋，直接被斩成了两半。
一颗闪闪发光的兽丹，滚了下来。
“第一头六阶野兽就爆出了兽丹！哈哈哈，这运气，简直没谁了！”
楚弛捡起兽丹，立马吃下了肚子。
六阶兽丹蕴含的能量，是四阶兽丹的九倍。
丹田和隐脉的灵气，变得越加明亮，越加浓郁！
只要再来一颗一级六阶兽丹，绝对能达到饱和。
“不错，希望接下来都有这样的好运！”
楚弛咧嘴一笑，用剑剥去了铁牙兔的皮。
皮，只收取小腹位置，只有这里的皮毛，才卖得出去。
随后，他又取下了铁牙兔的牙齿。
这牙齿，比皮毛更值钱。
楚弛确定四周没人，这才用意念将皮毛和牙齿收走了！
他用手摸了摸左手食指戴着的戒指，笑着道：“有储物戒指，真的太方便了。”
这储物戒指，也是女剑仙给的。

当时楚弛还激动了好一阵子！
储物戒指这种东西，他只是听过，见都没见过。
像楚家这样的小家族，别说拥有储物戒指，连最低级的储物袋，都没有几个。
唯一遗憾的是，女剑仙给楚弛的储物戒指里，什么资源都没有。
因为女剑仙，压根就没想过，要将楚弛培养起来。
他给楚弛一口鼎，也只是不想楚弛这一年，死在外面而已。
“继续寻找猎物！”
收好战利品，楚弛继续深入。
一天后，他又成功斩杀了五头六阶野兽，却没有一头给他留下兽丹。
“看来运气，没有之前好了啊。这么说，遇到五阶野兽，也得杀。必须得抓紧时间提升修为！”
时间流逝，楚弛进入野兽山岭整整三天了。
这三天，他猎杀了十二头六阶野兽，没有一头，给他留下兽丹。
之所以杀得这么少，因为六阶野兽，不好杀。
这些野兽，一旦知道不是对手，或者受了不轻的伤势，就会疯一般地逃跑。
除非楚弛一击必杀，不然，还真难留下他们。
但六阶野兽难杀，五阶野兽，就容易多了。
这三天，他猎杀了八十头五阶野兽，成功得到四颗一级五阶兽丹，应该也够了。
楚弛寻了一处小山，背依小山，开始服用兽丹。
第三颗五阶兽丹下肚后，体内的能量，已经达到了饱和。
楚弛没有迟疑，开始冲击第五条隐脉。

《大道自然诀》再次运转。
体内灵气，化为细针。
以以点破面的方式，疯狂撞击第五条隐脉的端口。
短短十几分钟后，端口破了！
楚弛成功进入凡人境五层。
但他没有欣喜，反而觉得修为提升还是不够快！
“三天，才提升一层修为……太慢了。与楚寻意的约战，还有不到七天，至少要将修为再提升两层。”
其实，凡人境五层，楚弛就有底气对付楚寻意了！
因为修为提升了两层，他有自信，掌握完整的七剑斩。
他之所以不满足，是因为他知道，他的敌人，不只是凡人境七层的楚寻意，还有整个庞家。
同一时间，楚家。
楚弛离家三天，楚寻意都快急疯了。
“三天了，这小子外出一直都没有回来！我就知道，我不该相信他的话！我居然如此天真。这小子，肯定跑了。”
当然，楚家不只楚寻意这样认为。
几乎所有楚家长辈都是这样认为的。
楚枫等小辈，更是不停嘲讽。
“我还以为楚弛那小子，真有自信挑战四伯父。现在看来，完全就是缓兵之计。现在都不知道跑哪里去了。”
“七哥，你真的跑了吗？”
唯有楚盈盈，对楚弛逃跑一事，抱有怀疑的态度。
那日楚弛说的话，和他的眼神，并不像是在说假话。
content_en:
"No wonder the female sword fairy gave me this cauldron. This is so outrageous."
"Hehe, she is willing to give me such a heaven-defying thing. There is no doubt that she has been conquered by me and must have fallen in love with me. Yes, this is the only explanation."
"Keep hunting the beast."
Chu Chi went all the way deep, and soon, a first-level and fifth-level beast appeared in front of him.
As long as he is not hit by a level five beast, Chu Chi can easily kill it by using "Seven Swords Slash".
This time, after killing twenty beasts, he got a fifth-level beast elixir.
Without hesitation, he swallowed the fifth-level beast elixir.
Under the influence of the mysterious power of the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron, the energy of the Beast Pill was completely transformed and absorbed by his body.
The spiritual energy in his Dantian and hidden veins became brighter at a speed visible to the naked eye!
"Sure enough, if the level of the beast pill is higher than my cultivation level, it will help me the most. At this rate, with three or five more first-level and fifth-level beast pills, I can reach the fifth level of the mortal realm!"
"However, the probability of forming a beast elixir is very low. I'm afraid it would be a waste of time to hunt at least a hundred first- and fifth-level beasts. Why not just kill the first- and sixth-level beasts? Maybe one beast elixir is enough!"
I have to say that Chu Chi’s idea is crazy.
He actually planned to go beyond two levels of cultivation to kill the beast.
You know, the bodies of beasts have always been stronger than humans.
At the same level, the beast is invincible. Unless the cultivator has learned martial arts that are stronger than his own.
Going all the way deep, Chu Chi searched for the elixir and the wild beasts at the same time.
Three hours later, he finally discovered the first first- and sixth-level beast.
This is a rabbit with red eyes, but its size is ten times larger than an ordinary rabbit.
Those sharp teeth can easily bite through large trees.
"It's actually Iron Fang Rabbit!"
Chu Chi turned around and left without saying a word.
He can indeed kill the Iron-toothed Rabbit, but only if the Iron-toothed Rabbit does not dodge or run away!
However, the rabbit's speed is definitely not slow.
If he cannot kill with one strike, he will anger the Iron-toothed Rabbit and be chased by the Iron-toothed Rabbit.
Unless, he uses the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron!
The Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron is so hard that it can not only defend itself, but also directly crush wild beasts to death with its tens of thousands of kilograms of strength.
But how could the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron be used in broad daylight?
There are still other cultivators in Beast Mountain.
Chu Chi was about to retreat when his eyes suddenly narrowed.
"No, it seems to be injured!"
This Iron Tower Rabbit was squatting on the ground, and there was blood under it.
Chu Chi thought for a moment, picked up a stone, and threw it at Tieya Rabbit from a distance.
Tieya Rabbit's ears are sensitive and he senses the sound of the wind and immediately runs away!
But Chu Chi could see clearly that Tieya Rabbit's body was stumbling. One of its legs was broken.
The other leg also has scars!
It just dodged and fell to the ground.
"Hahaha, God help me!"
Chu Chi didn't know who this Iron-toothed Rabbit had fought with, but it was made into a wedding dress for him!
Chu Chi held a long sword and rushed over quickly.
Tie Ya Rabbit sensed the crisis and ran away!
However, one leg was broken and the other was injured.
Its speed is extremely slow.
After Chu Chi caught up with him, he thrust out his sword.
Five sword lights appeared next to Tieya Rabbit.
One of the sword lights fell on Tieya Rabbit's head.
Tieya Rabbit's head was cut in half.
A sparkling beast pill rolled down.
"The first sixth-level beast exploded with the beast elixir! Hahaha, this is so lucky, no one else can!"
Chu Chi picked up the beast pill and ate it immediately.
The energy contained in the sixth-level beast elixir is nine times that of the fourth-level beast elixir.
The spiritual energy in Dantian and hidden veins becomes brighter and richer!
As long as there is another first-level and sixth-level beast elixir, it will definitely reach saturation.
"Not bad, I hope you have such good luck in the future!"
Chu Chi grinned and peeled off the iron-toothed rabbit's skin with his sword.
Skin, only collect the lower abdomenLocation, only the skin here can sell it.
Then, he took out the teeth of the Iron-toothed Rabbit.
These teeth are more valuable than the fur.
Chu Chi made sure there was no one around, so he used his mind to take away the fur and teeth!
He touched the ring on his left index finger and said with a smile, "It's really convenient to have a storage ring."
This storage ring was also given by the female sword fairy.
Chu Chi was excited for a while!
He had only heard of such things as storage rings, but had never seen them before.
A small family like the Chu family doesn't even have the lowest storage bags, let alone storage rings.
The only regret is that there are no resources in the storage ring that the female sword fairy gave Chu Chi.
Because the female sword fairy never thought about cultivating Chu Chi.
He gave Chu Chi a tripod just because he didn't want Chu Chi to die outside this year.
"Keep looking for prey!"
After collecting the loot, Chu Chi continued to go deeper.
One day later, he successfully killed five sixth-level beasts, but none of them left him with beast elixirs.
"It seems that our luck is not as good as before. So, if you encounter a fifth-level beast, you have to kill it. You must seize the time to improve your cultivation!"
Time passed, and Chu Chi entered the Beast Mountain Range for three full days.
In the past three days, he hunted twelve sixth-level beasts, and not one of them left him with a beast elixir.
The reason why there are so few kills is because sixth-level beasts are difficult to kill.
Once these beasts know that they are no match or are seriously injured, they will run away like crazy.
Unless Chu Chi kills them with one strike, it will be difficult to keep them.
But the sixth-level beast is difficult to kill, but the fifth-level beast is much easier.
In the past three days, he hunted eighty fifth-level beasts and successfully obtained four first-level and fifth-level beast pills, which should be enough.
Chu Chi found a hill, leaned against the hill, and started taking the beast elixir.
After taking the third level five beast pill, the energy in the body has reached saturation.
Chu Chi did not hesitate and began to attack the fifth hidden vein.
"The Natural Secret of the Great Dao" is in operation again.
The spiritual energy in the body turned into fine needles.
Using the method of arranging the surface, wildly hit the port of the fifth hidden vein.
After just ten minutes, the port was broken!
Chu Chi successfully entered the fifth level of the mortal realm.
But instead of being happy, he felt that his cultivation level was still not improving fast enough!
"Three days to raise one level of cultivation... it's too slow. There are less than seven days left for the battle with Chu Xunyi, so we need to raise the level of cultivation by at least two more levels."
In fact, at the fifth level of the mortal realm, Chu Chi had the confidence to deal with Chu Xunyi!
Because his cultivation level has improved by two levels, he has the confidence to master the complete Seven Sword Slashes.
The reason why he was dissatisfied was because he knew that his enemy was not only Chu Xunyi at the seventh level of the mortal realm, but also the entire Pang family.
At the same time, the Chu family.
Chu Chi had been away from home for three days, and Chu Xunyi almost went crazy with anxiety.
"It's been three days, and this kid hasn't come back since he went out! I knew I shouldn't believe what he said! I'm so naive. This kid must have run away."
Of course, Chu Xunyi is not the only one in the Chu family who thinks so.
Almost all the elders of the Chu family think so.
Chu Feng and other juniors kept mocking him.
"I thought that boy Chu Chi was really confident in challenging the fourth uncle. But now it seems that it was just a delaying tactic. I don't know where he went now."
"Brother Qi, did you really run away?"
Only Chu Yingying was skeptical about Chu Chi's escape.
What Chu Chi said that day, and the look in his eyes, didn't seem like he was telling lies.
